overview: Checkout writes a payment order and an outbox event in one transaction. A relay publishes outbox events to a queue; payment executors call the PSP with retries and the idempotency key; results update the ledger. Wallet balances are derived from ledger entries.

estimation.assumption: Illustrative ledger: 1K payments/s, at least two postings/payment.
estimation.calculation: 1,000 × 2 = 2,000 ledger entry inserts/s, plus intent and outbox updates.
estimation.result: Provider calls and transactional writes have different latency/throughput budgets.
estimation.implication: Partition by account/merchant when needed, while preserving transaction atomicity and idempotency.

entityDetails.purpose: Payment intent and authoritative state machine.
accessPatterns: Create by idempotency key; apply provider response or callback idempotently.
constraints: Bind idempotency key to amount/currency/customer; reject reuse with a different payload.
relationships: LedgerEntry.transaction_id groups balanced postings for the payment business transaction; refunds append linked reversals.

accessPatterns: Append balanced entries in one transaction; derive account balances.
constraints: Sum signed amounts to zero per transaction/currency. Never edit a posted entry; append a reversal.
relationships: transaction_id groups balanced postings, linked to the payment business transaction identity.

apiDetails.purpose: Create or retrieve the same logical payment.
apiDetails.rationale: Return the prior result for the same key and payload. A timeout does not mean the provider failed; reconcile by provider reference.
Only an authorized caller sees this payment; settlement and payment authorization are distinct states.

steps.title: App → LB → Payment Orders → Payments + ledger
steps.explanation: Write payment intent and outbox in one transaction; return PROCESSING.

steps.title: Outbox relay → Payment commands → Payment executors → PSP
steps.explanation: Publish at least once and call the PSP with a stable idempotency key.

steps.title: Payment executors → Payments + ledger
steps.explanation: Record provider outcome and balanced ledger changes transactionally.

steps.title: Payment commands → Payment executors → PSP
steps.explanation: Retry/query the same payment reference after timeout, never a new charge identity.

steps.title: Reconciliation job → Payments + ledger
steps.explanation: Reconcile pending/stuck payments against provider status before finalizing.

failureCases.scenario: Provider charges but the response is lost
failureCases.handling: Do not issue a fresh logical charge. Retry/query with the same provider idempotency key, process signed webhooks idempotently and reconcile settlement files with immutable ledger entries.

alternatives: Use synchronous provider calls for simpler checkout when latency is acceptable. Use an outbox and executors for responsive asynchronous processing. Both require immutable balanced ledgers, stable provider identity and reconciliation.
